The '''Jerne system''' was located within the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jerne]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Jerni]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DKD" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">In "[[Dark Knight's Devilry]]," which depicts the [[mission to Jerne]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] wields his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|father's lightsaber]], which he acquires during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and loses during those of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Both ''A New Hope'' and ''Empire Strikes Back'' correspond to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively, per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> however, [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] had passed since the Jerni inhabited their homeworld. At some point, a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the planet, and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually established a [[Jerne City H.Q.|base]] there.<ref name="DKD" />

Between 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Mission to Jerne|traveled]] to the [[Star system/Legends|system]] in search of an artifact, known as the [[Eternity Crystal]], that they believed to be located on Jerne. Skywalker and Organa encountered several Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] there, which caused the pair's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to crash on the planet's surface. After discovering that, in reality, the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] did not exist, the Rebels left Jerne via a [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] Imperial [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|scout ship]].<ref name="DKD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jerne system first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Dark Knight's Devilry]]," which was written by [[Steve Moore]], illustrated by [[Alan Davis]], and first published in the [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 153|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 153]]<ref name="DKD" /> in [[January]] [[1982]].<ref name="Epic">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Original Marvel Years Vol. 3]]''</ref> It was first named by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square N-4.<ref name="TEA" />
